en.joke: My work-life balance is mostly me trying to remember if I already typed 'lol' into a professional email.
en.explanation: It captures the relatable, slightly anxious blur between casual online communication and professional etiquette in modern work culture.

zh.joke: 当代年轻人最大的矛盾是：既想躺平，又怕真躺平了被时代抛弃。最后发现最理想的状态是‘趴着’，既有躺的姿态，又能随时往前爬，完美诠释了‘积极废人’。

people.name: Garrett Wolfe
people.extract: Garrett Wolfe is an American former professional football player who was a running back in the National Football League (NFL). He was selected by the Chicago Bears in the third round of the 2007 NFL draft. He played his college football for the Northern Illinois Huskies.
highlights: Played college football for Northern Illinois Huskies

people.name: Mohamed Abdelaziz (Sahrawi politician)
people.extract: Mohamed Abdelaziz was the 3rd Secretary General of the Polisario Front, from 1976, and the President of the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic from 1982, until his death in 2016.
highlights: President of Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic (1982-2016)
Served as President until his death

people.name: John Brahm
people.extract: John Brahm was a German film and television director. His films include The Undying Monster (1942), The Lodger (1944), Hangover Square (1945), The Locket (1946), The Brasher Doubloon (1947), and the 3D horror film The Mad Magician (1954).
highlights: Directed 3D horror film The Mad Magician (1954)
